Events

AiKeyInput.title: AiKeyInput
AiKeyInput.description: An AI service's key, kept in secrets.toml (never in settings, never sent back); "" forgets it.

BriefOut.title: BriefOut
BriefOut.description: The morning brief (DESIGN §20.4), as data and as plain text.

Changed.title: Changed
Changed.description: A command that changed something without a richer answer.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description:
Something only you can decide, waiting in the Inbox (27 Oct: "decisions but in the inbox with a notification
symbol"): a lock that makes work late (`resolve`), or work that will be late (the options, or `late_accept`).

DocumentInput.title: DocumentInput
DocumentInput.description: A document to read for tasks: a syllabus, a handout, a screenshot. Text, or base64 for a PDF or image.

DocumentOut.title: DocumentOut
DocumentOut.description: A syllabus or handout you uploaded: whether it was read, and what came of it.

EffectOut.title: EffectOut
EffectOut.description: What accepting a suggested event would do (commands/effects.py). `event` False: not an event, nothing said.

FitInput.title: FitInput
FitInput.description: Do I have time for this? A change Friday tries on a copy of your plan and never keeps.

FitOut.title: FitOut
FitOut.description: Do I have time for this?: whether everything still fits with the change, in a sentence and in parts.

GoogleAccountOut.title: GoogleAccountOut
GoogleAccountOut.description: A connected Google account and what it lets Friday do.

GoogleClientInput.title: GoogleClientInput
GoogleClientInput.description: The OAuth client JSON downloaded from Google Cloud (a Desktop app's), as text.

GoogleConnectInput.title: GoogleConnectInput
GoogleConnectInput.description:
Which account to sign in: none to add one (Google's page asks which), or one already connected to sign it in
again (to allow Gmail, or when its sign-in expired).

GoogleConnectOut.title: GoogleConnectOut
GoogleConnectOut.description: Connecting Google from the app: how the sign-in started there is going, and what Google allows Friday.

LocalModelInput.title: LocalModelInput
LocalModelInput.description: An open model for Ollama to run on this Mac, by its name ("llama3.2:3b", "nate/instinct").

LogInput.title: LogInput
LogInput.description: Past work on an item, or (with `title`) something that happened, recorded as a fixed item.

MacCalendar.title: MacCalendar
MacCalendar.description: One of the Mac's calendars, as EventKit lists it.

MacEvent.title: MacEvent
MacEvent.description:
One occurrence of an event on the Mac: timed with an offset ("2026-10-23T09:00:00-04:00"), or whole days with
the end the day after the last ("2026-10-23" to "2026-10-24"), as Google gives them.

MacSyncInput.title: MacSyncInput
MacSyncInput.description: What the Mac app sees on the Mac's calendars, between `since` and `until` (times with an offset).

MacWriteOut.title: MacWriteOut
MacWriteOut.description:
A change to one of the Mac's events, for the Mac app to make through EventKit: its times (timed with an offset,
or whole days with the end the day after the last) and, if you renamed or moved it here, its title and place; a
delete; or a new event, made on that calendar (`create`).

MacWrittenInput.title: MacWrittenInput
MacWrittenInput.description: What the Mac app made of a change to one of the Mac's events (`mac_writes`).

MealLearnedOut.title: MealLearnedOut
MealLearnedOut.description: What a meal usually is, on weekdays or at weekends, once there are enough days of it.

MealLogInput.title: MealLogInput
MealLogInput.description: A meal you didn't tap: when you ate it, after the fact.

MealPlanOut.title: MealPlanOut
MealPlanOut.description: A meal you have most days with none planned (plan: true), or one planned that you mostly skip (false).

MealTimeOut.title: MealTimeOut
MealTimeOut.description: A meal routine planned well off when you eat it: its window moved to sit around your usual time.

OccurrenceChange.title: OccurrenceChange
OccurrenceChange.description:
One time of a repeat that isn't like the others (27 Oct: "salsa every Saturday except 11/14, and this Saturday
it's in Willard Straight Hall"): not that day, or another place, time or title that day.

OtherWay.title: OtherWay
OtherWay.description: Another way to plan the same work (COMBINED.md 25).

PinInput.title: PinInput
PinInput.description: The item's pins overlapping the new one, or the block it moves from (`from_start`–`from_end`), are replaced.

ProposalAnswerInput.title: ProposalAnswerInput
ProposalAnswerInput.description: Yes or no to a proposed rule (`kind` "rule") or to a wall question (`kind` "wall": yes keeps it hard).

ProposedAction.title: ProposedAction
ProposedAction.description: One change Claude proposes, as the command that makes it; nothing runs until you apply it.

QuestionsOut.title: QuestionsOut
QuestionsOut.description:
What the evening review asks (DESIGN §18.9): at most two comparisons a day, a rule proposal or a wall
question, and a check-in when state inference is on.

ReportInput.title: ReportInput
ReportInput.description: Something the app saw go wrong on your screen.

ReviewGap.title: ReviewGap
ReviewGap.description:
A task's time that day Friday can't account for (27 Oct: Review asks "only the gaps, by task"): blocks that
ended without a timer running, an answer, or the task checked off. Once answered, what you said.

RuleClashOut.title: RuleClashOut
RuleClashOut.description: What a rule is up against, when the plan bends it: the rule that gives way when it's kept, on which days.

RuleConflict.title: RuleConflict
RuleConflict.description: Two rules at odds, found from the rules themselves (`planner/contradictions.py`).

RuleWinInput.title: RuleWinInput
RuleWinInput.description: Your answer to "Which should win?": `winner` beats `loser` whenever they clash.

SetAsideOut.title: SetAsideOut
SetAsideOut.description: A suggestion the inbox didn't ask because you have it already (commands/duplicates.py).

SettleInput.title: SettleInput
SettleInput.description: A past block settled before the review: done, partly or not done.

SetupInput.title: SetupInput
SetupInput.description:
Your answers to the questions Friday asks when it first opens (Setup): each sets the settings and rules it's
about, all in one change you can undo.

SetupOut.title: SetupOut
SetupOut.description: Setup's questions, answered with what Friday does now; `done` once you've been through them.

SittingInput.title: SittingInput
SittingInput.description: A timed sitting as the calendar shows it: the item and its span (local), every timer record in it.

SourceInput.title: SourceInput
SourceInput.description: A calendar feed (`ics`, with `url`). Feeds can also be listed in `friday.toml`.

TemplateApplyInput.title: TemplateApplyInput
TemplateApplyInput.description: A project from a template: a parent item with one child per step, each after the one before.

WeekOut.title: WeekOut
WeekOut.description: The week (DESIGN §18.9; in Insights since 27 Oct): planned against actual by area, deadlines and moves.

WhatIfChange.title: WhatIfChange
WhatIfChange.description:
A change staged in What if, as the command that would make it. An item another staged change makes is named
by a placeholder id: -(1000 × that change's place + the item's place + 1).

WhatIfInput.title: WhatIfInput
WhatIfInput.description: What if: changes tried together on a copy of your plan; nothing is kept until you keep them.

WhatIfOut.title: WhatIfOut
WhatIfOut.description: What if: the calendar with the staged changes, and what they cost together, against the plan without them.
